title.en: Electric 20 Concrete Pump — B500S-83D prints 380 V — read beside “Work done”
title.zh: 邢台电动页把电压留空时，请发送现场电压——喷涂页印 220/380 V。——对照「功 完成」来读

description.en: Electric 20 Concrete Pump at /products/electric-20-concrete-pump. B500S-83D prints 380 V M9 prints 380 V / 50 Hz
description.zh: 邢台电动页把电压留空时，请发送现场电压见 /products/electric-20-concrete-pump。喷涂页印 220/380 V。511 和液压喷涂机印 380 V。

h1.en: Power transmitted is the heading; Electric 20 Concrete Pump stays the subject
h1.zh: 标题是「功率 transmitted」，主体仍是邢台电动页把电压留空时，请发送现场电压

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Electric 20 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/electric-20-concrete-pump. B500S-83D prints 380 V. M9 prints 380 V / 50 Hz. M9 prints 50 Hz with 380 V. It prints 220/380 V on the sprayer page. Type 511 and the hydraulic sprayers print 380 V. Do not copy 380 V onto those pump orders as if the sheet said it. Electric 20, Electric 40, Electric 60 and Electric 80 do not print a voltage cell on the lists used here. The section title “Work done” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是邢台电动页把电压留空时，请发送现场电压的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-20-concrete-pump。喷涂页印 220/380 V。511 和液压喷涂机印 380 V。B500S-83D 印 380 V。M9 印 380 V / 50 Hz。M9 把 50 Hz 和 380 V 印在一起。不要把 380 V 抄进这些泵的订单，好像表上写过一样。电动20、电动40、电动60和电动80在此处使用的列表上没有电压格。节标题「功 完成」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

body.en: “Work done” titles this part of the Electric 20 Concrete Pump note. The figures stay the printed ones. B500S-83D prints 380 V. It prints 220/380 V on the sprayer page. Electric 20, Electric 40, Electric 60 and Electric 80 do not print a voltage cell on the lists used here.
body.zh: 「功 完成」是邢台电动页把电压留空时，请发送现场电压这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。B500S-83D 印 380 V。喷涂页印 220/380 V。电动20、电动40、电动60和电动80在此处使用的列表上没有电压格。

body.en: For Electric 20 Concrete Pump, the heading “Power transmitted” does not replace a cell. M9 prints 380 V / 50 Hz. Type 511 and the hydraulic sprayers print 380 V.
body.zh: 对邢台电动页把电压留空时，请发送现场电压而言，标题「功率 transmitted」并不替换任何格子。M9 印 380 V / 50 Hz。511 和液压喷涂机印 380 V。

heading.en: Example - required Torque to produce Power
heading.zh: 示例 - 所需 扭矩 到 produce 功率

body.en: Electric 20 Concrete Pump is unchanged by the heading “Example - required Torque to produce Power”. M9 prints 50 Hz with 380 V. Do not copy 380 V onto those pump orders as if the sheet said it. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/work-torque-d_1377.html.
body.zh: 邢台电动页把电压留空时，请发送现场电压不因标题「示例 - 所需 扭矩 到 produce 功率」而改动。M9 把 50 Hz 和 380 V 印在一起。不要把 380 V 抄进这些泵的订单，好像表上写过一样。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/work-torque-d_1377.html。

question.en: Does “Work done” replace B500S-83D prints 380 V?
question.zh: 「功 完成」会替换「喷涂页印 220/380 V。」吗？

answer.en: No. B500S-83D prints 380 V remains the printed wording for Electric 20 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。喷涂页印 220/380 V。仍是邢台电动页把电压留空时，请发送现场电压已印的说法。

question.en: Where does M9 prints 380 V / 50 Hz belong on the Electric 20 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 邢台电动页把电压留空时，请发送现场电压这一行里，「511 和液压喷涂机印 380 V。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/electric-20-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/electric-20-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Power transmitted” add to Electric 20 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「功率 transmitted」给邢台电动页把电压留空时，请发送现场电压增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/work-torque-d_1377.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/work-torque-d_1377.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。

question.en: Is a list price printed beside B500S-83D prints 380 V?
question.zh: 「喷涂页印 220/380 V。」旁边印了标价吗？
